extension.summary: Norwegian weather forecasts from MET Norway (yr.no)
extension.description: "Are you using that Norwegian service?" — Norweather brings forecasts from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute (MET Norway, api.met.no), the same data as yr.no, to Kodi. Location search uses Kartverket's official place-name register, so it finds even the tiniest Norwegian places that other services miss. 7-day and hourly forecast, sunrise/sunset. No API key needed — just enter a contact e-mail (required by MET). Unofficial add-on, not affiliated with MET Norway or NRK/Yr.

Norweather henter værvarsel fra Meteorologisk institutt (MET Norway, api.met.no) — samme data som yr.no — inn i Kodi. Stedssøket bruker Kartverkets offisielle stedsnavnregister, så det finner selv de minste norske stedene som andre tjenester ikke har. 7-dagers- og timesvarsel, soloppgang/-nedgang. Ingen API-nøkkel nødvendig — bare legg inn en kontakt-epost (påkrevd av MET). Uoffisielt addon, ikke tilknyttet MET Norway eller NRK/Yr.
extension.news: v1.2.2: Renamed to Norweather. v1.2.1: Fixed missing forecast icons in Estuary (Kodi 21) by using Kodi's built-in weather-icon set with correct icon codes. v1.2.0: Contact e-mail now required with a clear prompt; transient errors no longer pop a scary dialog.
